title: Dependency Cruiser Config Modernization For Taxonomy Shape
description:
This is step M7 of the "mechanism wave" (W4) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Mechanism changes" Step 7.

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL, especially the note that a prior fix already made `.dependency-cruiser.cjs`'s hardcoded `PLUGINS` array self-correcting via `fs.readdirSync("✏️s/🔌️plugins")` (search "DEPENDENCY-CRUISER-CONFIG-STALENESS-FIXES") — verify that fix is still in place before building on top of it, don't duplicate it.
3. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️lib/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — M1's new shared vocabulary + discovery library, read in full.
4. `.dependency-cruiser.cjs` at repo root — read in full.

YOUR TASK:
- Verify the `no-generated-edits-upstream` rule's filename match is correct (the plan mentions `🔣️plugins.json` vs a stale `plugins.json` — confirm this was already fixed per the master doc note, or fix it now if it wasn't).
- Add a `no-impl-segment` rule that forbids any dependency path containing `⚡️implementations` or `⚡️implementation` (both spellings) segments — set this to WARN level for now (not error; the plan says promote warn→error only at finalization/W10, which is a separate future step).
- Add `no-cross-package-relative` rule(s): forbid deep relative imports that cross package boundaries (e.g. `../../../other-package/src/...`) in favor of package-name imports; the plan describes this as "$1-capture rules" — design the regex/capture group so imports within the SAME package (or its own subdirectories) are still allowed, only cross-package relative imports are flagged. Use M1's discovery library to determine package boundaries if useful, or a straightforward path-segment heuristic if that's simpler and sufficient — use your judgment, but justify the choice in your close-out summary.
- Add matching ESLint rule patterns (`no-restricted-imports` or similar) that mirror the dep-cruiser cross-package-import ban, so both tools agree (check if an ESLint config exists at repo root or per-package and where it makes sense to add this).

VERIFICATION: run the dependency-cruiser check command (find it via project.json/package.json scripts) before and after your changes. New WARN-level findings from `no-impl-segment` are EXPECTED (there are still real `⚡️implementations` dirs outside the plugin/demonstrator wave — framework/hub/etc. haven't been touched yet) — do not try to fix those, just confirm the rule correctly WARNS (not errors) and doesn't break the `verify gate` command. The `no-cross-package-relative` rule should ideally find ZERO or very few real violations if the codebase already mostly uses package-name imports — if it finds a large number, double-check your regex isn't over-broad before assuming they're all real.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, nx.json, package.json workspaces, .storybook, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, or any individual plugin/framework package's own source files.
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` on your own ticket's exact path with a full summary and file list. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of the new rules you added, their WARN-vs-error levels, and what they found when run against the real repo.
summary:
M7 (dep-cruiser) of the spicy-umbrella mechanism wave, done.

**Verified already-fixed (no duplication)**: `.dependency-cruiser.cjs`'s `PLUGINS` array is still `fs.readdirSync("✏️s/🔌️plugins")`-derived (self-correcting), and `no-generated-edits-upstream` already matches the real `🔣️plugins\.json` filename (not the stale `plugins.json`). Both confirmed in place from the earlier `DEPENDENCY-CRUISER-CONFIG-STALENESS-FIXES` fix — left untouched.

**Added `no-impl-segment` (WARN)**: bans any dependency whose RESOLVED path carries a `⚡️implementations`/`⚡️implementation` segment (both spellings pulled from M1's `🔣️taxonomy.json` `forbiddenPathSegments` via a plain `JSON.parse(readFileSync(...))` — no TS toolchain needed from this `.cjs`, and it can never drift from the shared vocabulary). Real run against the repo: 252 WARN hits, 0 errors, exit 0 — every hit is inside `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🧑️‍💻️dev/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔌️plugin-modules/` (the generated wasm-bundle build output flagged in master.md as 399MB dead weight awaiting W8c deletion), i.e. real, legitimate, WARN-only findings from an untouched area, exactly as expected — not fixed, per instructions.

**Added `no-cross-package-relative` (WARN, the "$1-capture rule")**: `from` captures the owning family (`🧰️framework/🛍️products/<X>`, `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/<X>`, `✏️s/🔨️modules/<X>`, `🌎️hub/🔨️modules/<X>`, `♻️mit-bestand/<X>`), `to` (relative/`local` deps only) must stay under that same `$1` prefix. Deliberately excludes `✏️s/🔌️plugins/*` (already an ERROR via existing `crossPluginRules`, no redundant WARN needed) and excludes `📦️packages/<lang>`-anchored boundaries (considered and rejected — see design note in the file: most areas are still legacy sandwiches, so that anchor would barely match anything yet; a directory-family heuristic covers the real, present-day gap instead of requiring M1's `discoverPackages()` TS/ESM library inside a plain `.cjs`). Also excludes `📜️script.ts` files by name: every plugin/module's bootstrap script relative-imports repo-lib across a family boundary by established, load-bearing convention (the same pattern the pre-existing `no-escaping-relative-imports` rule's own comment explicitly protects — "do not fix it into a specifier-depth rule, that would break every script.ts in the repo"); without this exclusion the rule would have been pure noise on an already-litigated non-issue rather than a new finding. Real run: 0 hits (ideal, matches the ticket's own success bar).

**Added the ESLint mirror** in `eslint.config.mjs` (the only root flat config; `compose/dev/algorithm/js/eslint.config.ts` is compose's own, out of scope): generates one config-override object per family member (same `fs.readdirSync`-derived, self-correcting style as the dep-cruiser `PLUGINS`/`crossPluginRules` pattern) with `no-restricted-imports` at `"warn"`, patterns banning any sibling family member's name appearing in a relative specifier, `ignores: ["**/📜️script.ts"]` matching the dep-cruiser exclusion. Verified via `bunx eslint --print-config` (rule resolves correctly per-file) and a real lint run over 🧰️framework/✏️s/🌎️hub/♻️mit-bestand: initially 87 warn hits (86 of which were exactly the sanctioned script.ts→repo-lib pattern — confirmed as noise, not real findings, which is what motivated the script.ts exclusion above); after excluding script.ts, only 4 real WARN hits remain, all genuine cross-module-family relative imports worth having on record (🖱️ui/🖼️assets ⇄ 🧮️math/🕸️graph, 🖼️assets ⇄ 🖱️ui, and repo-lib ⇄ os's plugin-registry generated catalog). 0 errors introduced by either new rule in either tool; pre-existing lint error counts are untouched (only WARN-severity rules were added).

**Design choice justified**: used a directory-name path-segment heuristic rather than wiring M1's `discoverPackages()`/`🟦️discovery.ts` into either config — that library is ESM/TS meant for the registry/root-policy scripts, and both `.dependency-cruiser.cjs` and `eslint.config.mjs` are plain CJS/MJS with no build step; `📦️packages/<lang>` (the taxonomy's real package unit) is Shape V2 end-state and most governed areas are still legacy sandwiches today, so anchoring there would barely match anything yet. The heuristic does directly consume `🔣️taxonomy.json`'s `forbiddenPathSegments` for `no-impl-segment` (plain JSON require, zero drift risk), and mirrors it in spirit for the cross-package rule.

**Verification commands run** (the exact command `📜️script.ts`'s `VerifyScript`/`LintScript` use): `bunx dependency-cruiser@16 compose 🧰️framework ✏️s 🌎️hub ♻️mit-bestand --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err` — before: clean (200 modules/309 deps, 0 violations); after: exit 0, 252 warnings/0 errors (252 warnings, 0 errors) — verify gate stays green since `--output-type err` only fails on error-severity findings. Did not run the full multi-hour `verify gate`/cargo suite (out of scope — unrelated to dep-cruiser/eslint, and 🏗️fem is a known separate in-flight blocker for the rust side).

**Note for whoever next touches dep-cruiser**: discovered (pre-existing, NOT introduced or fixed here, out of this ticket's scope) that the real `bunx dependency-cruiser@16 <dirs> ...` invocation cruises 0 `.ts`/`.tsx` files repo-wide — only `.js`/`.mjs` (mostly the generated `🔌️plugin-modules` bundle output) — meaning dependency-cruiser is currently blind to the entire hand-written TypeScript source tree. Confirmed by direct-file-target tests (pointing dependency-cruiser at a specific `.ts` file DOES cruise it correctly) vs directory-arg scans (which silently skip all `.ts` sources). Root cause not diagnosed (likely a `tsPreCompilationDeps`/ts-config-discovery interaction) — flagging for a future ticket since fixing it would surface a large number of NEW findings across every existing rule, not just the two added here, and is unrelated to this ticket's scope.
